description: QoL #2 — Copy-to-clipboard on identifiers. Wrap Cloudscape's CopyToClipboard (CONFIRMED present in @cloudscape-design/components@3.0.1356) in a thin CopyId component with tests, then add an unobtrusive copy affordance next to identifier values across the app: fleet run ID + workflow ID columns, run-detail orientation strip IDs, inputs/outputs S3 URIs, run configuration ARNs/S3 URIs, and the task detail panel task ID. Displayed text stays unchanged; a copy affordance appears ONLY beside values that are present (absent values keep '—', no fabrication). Independent of the other features.
steps: Create frontend/src/components/CopyId.tsx: `CopyId({ value, label, variant = 'inline' }: { value: string; label?: string; variant?: 'inline' | 'icon' | 'button' })` rendering `<CopyToClipboard variant={variant} textToCopy={value} textToDisplay={variant === 'inline' ? value : undefined} copyButtonAriaLabel={label ?? 'Copy'} copySuccessText="Copied" copyErrorText="Copy failed" />`. Import default from '@cloudscape-design/components/copy-to-clipboard'. Use variant='inline' where the id text itself should carry the copy affordance (keeps displayed text) and variant='icon' where a bare affordance sits beside existing text/links.

Create frontend/src/components/CopyId.test.tsx: stub navigator.clipboard.writeText (Object.defineProperty with { writeText: vi.fn().mockResolvedValue(undefined) }) in beforeEach; assert the displayed value text is present (unchanged) for the inline variant, clicking the copy button (getByRole('button', { name: /copy/i })) calls writeText with the exact value and surfaces the success flash text, and copyButtonAriaLabel is applied. Restore in afterEach.

Edit frontend/src/fleet/FleetView.tsx: in the `runId` column cell render the id text with `<CopyId value={run.runId} label={`Copy run ID ${run.runId}`} />`; in the `workflowId` column cell render `<CopyId value={run.workflowId} label="Copy workflow ID" />` only when run.workflowId != null, otherwise keep '—' with no copy affordance. Leave the Workflow (name) link column untouched.

Edit frontend/src/rundetail/RunDetailView.tsx: (a) in RunOrientationStrip add a CopyId beside the Run ID value and, when present, the Workflow ID value; (b) in S3Value keep the console Link as the displayed text and add a sibling `<CopyId variant='icon' value={uri} label='Copy S3 URI' />` that copies the raw s3:// URI (NOT the console URL) — covers inputs/outputs params and the output location; (c) in the run configuration table value cell, when the value starts with 'arn:' or 's3://' render the existing Box variant='samp' text plus a `<CopyId variant='icon' .../>`. Absent config values are already filtered out of runConfigEntries, so no fabrication.

Edit frontend/src/rundetail/TaskDetailPanel.tsx: in TaskResourceDetail add a 'Task ID' key/value row (Box variant='awsui-key-label' label + the task.taskId text + `<CopyId variant='icon' value={task.taskId} label='Copy task ID' />`), rendered only when task != null (the existing null-task guard already returns null).

Update frontend/src/fleet/FleetView.test.tsx, frontend/src/rundetail/RunDetailView.test.tsx, and the TaskDetailPanel test: add assertions that a copy button exists next to the run ID, an S3 URI, the IAM role ARN, and the task ID; assert an absent workflow ID still shows '—' with no copy button. Stub navigator.clipboard where a click is exercised. Keep existing assertions passing.
acceptance_criteria: `npx vitest run src/components/CopyId.test.tsx` passes; clicking copy calls navigator.clipboard.writeText with the exact value and shows the success feedback.
Copy affordances appear beside: fleet run ID & workflow ID (when present), run-detail run ID / workflow ID, inputs/outputs S3 URIs, run configuration ARNs/S3 URIs, and the task detail task ID.
Displayed identifier text is unchanged; absent values (e.g. missing workflow ID) still render '—' with NO copy affordance.
No new npm dependency is added (CopyToClipboard ships in the pinned Cloudscape 3.0.1356); package.json is unchanged.
`npx vitest run src/fleet src/rundetail src/components` is green and `npm run build` + `npm run lint` succeed.

findings: Added frontend/src/components/CopyId.tsx (+ CopyId.test.tsx), a thin wrapper over Cloudscape's default export from '@cloudscape-design/components/copy-to-clipboard' (confirmed present in pinned 3.0.1356, no dependency added). Props: { value, label?, variant='inline'|'icon'|'button' }; forwards textToCopy=value, textToDisplay=value only for inline, copyButtonAriaLabel=label??'Copy', copySuccessText='Copied', copyErrorText='Copy failed'. Variant usage: FleetView runId/workflowId columns use the default INLINE variant (keeps the id text as the display); run-detail orientation strip Run ID / Workflow ID, S3Value (sibling of the console Link, copies the raw s3:// URI not the console URL), run-configuration ARN/s3:// value cells, and TaskDetailPanel's new 'Task ID' row all use variant='icon' beside existing text/links. No-fabrication honored: copy affordance only beside present values; absent workflowId keeps '—' with no button; absent run-config entries are already filtered out of runConfigEntries. Verified: `npx vitest run src/components/CopyId.test.tsx` (3) and `npx vitest run src/fleet src/rundetail src/components` (277 total) pass; `npm run lint` and `npm run build` (tsc --noEmit && vite build) succeed; package.json and package-lock.json unchanged (git diff clean). Note: FEAT-003.verification's package.json check path is 'frontend/package.json' but is run from the frontend dir, so it does not match the actual file; confirmed package.json/package-lock.json unchanged directly instead.
